$comment: The Stocktake Run's probe prompts (spec §6): each written on purpose to exercise behaviour no golden prompt reaches — a form pack at 0 % reach, a two-place prompt, an unusual era or climate, terrain-only, an icon that lives in a prop pack, a bizarre bespoke ask. One world each, judged by the icon metric; a probe that fails is promoted into prompts.json once its cause is fixed, passes stay one-off. Run with `run.mjs --prompts tools/golden-prompts/probes.json --label probe-N` and score with `icon-metric.mjs runs/probe-N --prompts tools/golden-prompts/probes.json`.

prompts.prompt: A Himalayan monastery clinging to a cliff face above a glacier, prayer flags strung across the gorge, a village of yak herders on the moraine below.
watches: himalayan_monastery pack at 0 % reach in the before-sample
a settlement split by a gorge — does the kit route the flags or drop them
cold climate and the snow line

prompts.prompt: Two rival fishing villages on opposite shores of a narrow fjord, one of stone and one of timber, joined only by a rope ferry.
watches: two-regions-in-one-world (the kit module exists; no golden prompt asks for two places)
the ferry — a bespoke program or nothing

prompts.prompt: A Bronze Age tin-mining camp on a frozen tundra coast in midwinter: pit heads, smelting fires, hide tents and a beached trading ship.
watches: an era the kit's tables barely name, in a climate no golden prompt uses
era fidelity (T9): no later-era archetypes or materials
the beached ship — beached_wreck is a pack member

prompts.prompt: A volcanic caldera lake with black-sand shores, steaming vents along the rim and a lava tube opening on the outer slope — no settlement of any kind.
watches: terrain-only against the terrain kit: no golden prompt is terrain-only
the vents and the lava tube — edits or programs
a lake inside a rim: the basin rim must close (T105)

prompts.prompt: A feudal Japanese hill village of terraced paddies, with a great bronze temple bell in its own pavilion on the ridge above, rung at dusk.
watches: the icon lives in a prop pack (bell_pavilion) — does the model reach for the pack member or invent a program

prompts.prompt: A desert town built inside the ribcage of a fossilised sky-whale: the ribs form the market hall, the skull is the temple, and the spine is the main street.
watches: T8: bespoke is non-negotiable — a whale skeleton the town lives in
a program the town must be laid out around (seating, facing, the street along the spine)
